title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning and harden audit logging for residency
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region pinning and improve audit logging for data residency decisions. This PR implements enforcement paths in the policy engine so that requests which reference customer KMS keys are validated against configured region residency policies, emits structured audit events for region pinning decisions (allowed/denied/fallback), adds additional context to audit logs (tenant_id, policy_id, requested_region, resolved_region, reason), and hardens the audit pipeline to guarantee delivery to the secure audit store with retries and backoff. Also includes a migration path and feature-flagged rollout: v2_rbac_kms_region_enforce disabled by default, with an audit-only mode enabled in prod for two weeks before flipping enforcement. Updates the docs and adds e2e and unit tests. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require enforceable region residency controls tied to KMS residency; previous implementation only audited but did not reliably prevent cross-region key usage. This change closes that gap and adds observability for post-mortems. Linear: ENG-9123 and SEC-204 are tracked. The PR contains a checklist for rollout and a small migration helper to annotate KMS bindings for existing tenants.

release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning via RBAC v2 and strengthen audit logging. Feature is behind v2_rbac_kms_region_enforce flag and will be initially enabled in audit-only mode. Administrators should review migration doc docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md and run migration helper for annotated KMS bindings.
rollout_plan: 1) Enable audit-only mode in production for 14 days and monitor rbac.kms_region_pin.denied_total
2) Notify customers with existing cross-region KMS bindings and provide migration helper
3) Flip per-org enforcement flag for pilot tenants (5 customers)
4) Gradually enable enforcement globally after pilot (target 3 weeks)
5) Post-rollout: rotate audit signing keys as scheduled maintenance
migration_instructions: Run migrations/2026_02_annotate_kms_bindings.go against tenant DB in dry-run mode
Validate annotated bindings via admin CLI: ./bin/admin validate-kms-bindings --tenant <tenant_id>
If validation fails, run rollback using admin CLI: ./bin/admin rollback-kms-annotation --migration 2026_02
Coordinate with customer success to notify affected tenants
testing_strategy: Unit tests for policy engine decision matrix
Integration tests against kms-emulator covering allow/deny/fallback and audit delivery
Load test for audit writer retry path to ensure backpressure resilience
End-to-end verification using private installer in a sandbox region
